news.title: Fresh off bond sale, Amazon borrows $17.5B from banks as AI spending continues
news.description: Companies are burning through exorbitant sums of money to keep pace in the AI arms race. Debt is climbing.

news.title: ‘AI-pilled’ firms spend $7,500 per employee each month on AI
news.description: The most AI-obsessed firms are spending roughly $7,500 monthly per employee on AI, per Ramp AI Index. That's not more than an engineer's salary — yet.

news.title: How memory tools can make AI models worse
news.description: New research suggests that AI memory systems can degrade model performance and encourage sycophantic tendencies.

news.title: Cybersecurity researchers aren’t happy about the guardrails on Anthropic’s Fable
news.description: Cybersecurity researchers are complaining that Anthropic's new model Fable has guardrails that are too strict for any cybersecurity work.

news.title: Datadog veterans launch AI coding startup Niteshift on a bet against Big AI lock-in
news.description: AI coding agent startup Niteshift has raised a $7 million seed round from a who's who of angels. It's betting companies will want power over, not lock-in with model makers.

news.title: Kalshi to make some users reveal job details to tackle insider trading
news.description: After issues with insider trading, the prediction betting platform is adding new rules.

news.title: Version of AI tool 'too powerful for public' released to public
news.description: Claude Fable 5 is a version of Anthropic's Claude Mythos, an AI program which caused a stir among technology, finance, and government leaders.

news.title: Farage says Reform has contacted X 'to highest level' over fake AI ads
news.description: The fake ads feature the governor of the Bank of England - the Bank has urged people to report them.
